chapter: Duke, Gensel and the later years
title: Annual church programs for Reverend Gensel
summary: He plays Easter and Christmas programs for Gensel.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: And you've continued your association with Reverend Gensel over the years.
Oh yeah. We were always... Well, see, then he started putting on the All Souls Night...
Oh yeah, the All Night Soul?

Yeah, the All Night Soul. And I always play the Easter programs, the Christmas programs for him, to keep the thing going and (?). So I'll be playing this time the day after Christmas. But I generally play a week before Christmas, the Sunday a week before Christmas...
What kind of a group are you going to have?
Well, just a quartet or a quintet. Maybe a quintet. I'll play the 26th of December, bring a quintet into the church. You don't never come down there.
I'm going to try to come this time.
It won't hurt you, you know. We'll try not to insult you!
